verdict: 8/12 axes won, 1 tied, 3 lost — best in the set on verifiability, cost, privacy, determinism and exactness; not competitive on capability breadth.

axes.label: Accuracy on the numeric ledger suite (held-out)
axes.rank: 1st of 101 (tied with the top hosted model; ahead of the flash tier)
axes.note: Both top-tier and RAREXT answer every held-out item correctly; RAREXT is exact by construction, the sampled model by luck of the sample.

axes.label: Byte-exact answer format
axes.note: Hosted models answer '$1,403' or 'mini shark'; RAREXT emits the contract string deterministically.

axes.label: Same prompt → same bytes
axes.best: no hosted system in the registry publishes a byte-identical guarantee
axes.rank: 1st of 101 (the only system in the set that publishes the guarantee)
axes.note: Sampled decoding is not reproducible across providers; RAREXT's is a deployment requirement.

axes.label: Answer bound to the weights that produced it
axes.rarext: yes — one flipped byte makes the page refuse to load
axes.best: none of the 100 APIs returns the weights digest with the answer
axes.note: refusal: weights digest mismatch: got c75612586e3590ac…, pinned 6e449058edfeda0…

axes.label: Answers with the network removed
axes.note: Measured by replacing global fetch with a thrower before answering.

axes.label: Bytes of the prompt that leave the device
axes.note: Consequence of the offline measurement: no socket is opened to answer.

axes.label: Marginal cost per 1M output tokens
axes.rarext: $0 — no account, no quota, no meter
axes.best: median $0.6/1M, p90 $15, max $180 (opencode/gpt-5.5-pro); 34/100 are $0 with a quota
axes.rank: 1st of 101 on price; the only $0 entry with no quota
axes.note: The 34 free registry entries are rate-limited free tiers; RAREXT is unmetered because the compute is the visitor's own tab.

axes.label: Latency for the ledger answer
axes.rarext: 0.002 ms median (exact tool), 48 ms (neural path, 16 tokens)
axes.best: hosted round-trip: network + queue + generation, ~1 s class
axes.note: The exact tool does no model compute at all.

axes.label: Deployable size that serves an answer
axes.note: The whole model is smaller than one product photo.

axes.label: Context window
axes.best: 128k–1M tokens on the top hosted models
axes.note: The rebuild is a 128-dim, 8-block, 192-context host. This is the honest ceiling of the artifact.

axes.label: Vision / audio / video input
axes.rarext: none on the in-tab model (named refusal)
axes.best: standard on the top hosted models
axes.note: Forwarded deployments pass images through; the local model has no tower.

axes.label: Open-ended knowledge and reasoning breadth
axes.note: Not measured here because pretending to measure it would be the dishonest part. Named as a loss.
